archetype: VIBRANT PLAY + PASTEL & SOFT (Youth Coaching & Approachability)

typography.headings_font: Fredoka or Nunito (Playful, welcoming for teens)
typography.body_font: Figtree or Fira Sans (Clean, readable for dense test content)
rules: NO Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Headlines (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing.
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Use large line-height (leading-relaxed or leading-loose) for AI-generated notes to improve readability.
Strictly Light Theme (easy on the eyes).
The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutral greys.
Contrast Check: Normal text minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Dark slate text (#2D3436) on light pastels.
Hover state color must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color.
Use 'Neo-Brutalist' contrast: Pair soft pastels with solid/dark borders to avoid looking childish.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (The 'Tactile' Variant) - mix soft shadows with sharp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded corners (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl) for friendly feel, paired with bold borders on interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle grain textures in the background to kill digital flatness. Soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm) on cards.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for DPPS and recent tests.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_grid: MODE A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetry, Visual Tension for landing/login pages.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

rules: Entrance animations staggered for lists (DPP, tests).
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).

general: Use Shadcn UI for standard interactions (dropdowns, tabs, dialogs).
Forms: Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox. Do NOT use native inputs.
Date Pickers for Test activation: Shadcn Calendar.
custom: AI Notes Reader: Wide reading layout, prominent concept images, distinct sections.
MCQ Test Runner: Sticky header with countdown timer, clean un-distracting layout.
Teacher Upload: Large dropzone area with clear supported formats (PDF/image/docx/text).

accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='upload-notes-button').
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.

media.3d_libraries: Framer Motion for simple card flips (like flashcards for notes) and page transitions.
media.icons: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) for a premium friendly feel.

student_studying.description: Teen student concentrating, good for student dashboard or landing page hero.

teacher.description: Teacher at desk smiling, perfect for teacher dashboard landing.

abstract_shapes.description: Colorful abstract 3D shapes for AI-generated concept notes imagery to make them beautiful and memorable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns. If content scrolls under, use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) + 1px border.
Use pill-shaped or rounded modern buttons (rounded-full).
Never use AI emoji characters for icons.
Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (.jsx / .js files ONLY. NO .tsx).
Don't center everything. Left-align dense content.
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' look by combining soft pastels with bold, dark text and structural borders.
DO NOT overuse Shadcn cards for everything; go cardless or use flat borders for variety.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
